description: Scan one URL for readiness to be cited by AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) and used by AI agents. Returns scores and the fix checklist: prioritized problems with concrete fixes. Uses one API credit per call, so re-scan only after deploying a change. scope='content' or 'crawlability' runs a narrower, faster scan.

url.description: Full http(s) URL of the page to scan

wait.description: Wait up to about 25s for the result (default). Slower scans, or false, return a report ID to poll with check_status.

name: analyze_website
title: Scan a page for AI readiness
